invariants.name: modular_factorial_inverse
invariants.description: The arrays factorial and invFactorial satisfy factorial[i] ≡ i! (mod MOD) and invFactorial[i] ≡ (i!)^{-1} (mod MOD) for all i, maintained by the recurrences factorial[i] = i * factorial[i-1] mod MOD and invFactorial[i] = invFactorial[i-1] * i^{-1} mod MOD using linear inverse computation, guaranteeing correct binomial coefficient queries.
